\title{Black Hole Entropy from\\ Near-Horizon Microstates}
\author{A. Author \and B. Author}
\date{}
\begin{document}
\maketitle
\begin{abstract}
We count the microstates of a near-extremal black hole and match the Bekenstein--Hawking entropy.
\end{abstract}
\section{Introduction}
The entropy of a black hole is proportional to the area of its horizon.
